lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Observed multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits. The primary row along the mid-flank exhibits regular horizontal spacing. A secondary row of smaller clusters is positioned dorsally to the primary row.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical pale bands are visible crossing the flank. The high-luminance blobs are consistently positioned at the center-points where these vertical bands intersect with horizontal alignment axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least two longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient. These features maintain a linear horizontal trajectory across the visible dorsal-lateral field.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, high-luminance spots across its entire dorsal surface, contrasting with the larger, more widely spaced spots on the lateral flank.
